publicLabel: This is a preregistered pilot on a 18-question LongMemEval slice—not a result on the full 500-question benchmark—with arms, seeds, models, and judge settings fixed before protected scoring.
claimBoundary: Aggregate-only exploratory pilot analysis. It contains no protected prompts, evidence, gold, item identifiers, hypotheses, judge reasons, or raw model outputs and does not establish benchmark superiority.
